Sen Kaibara (Sports Festival).name: Sen Kaibara (Sports Festival)
Sen Kaibara (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Sen Kaibara, hero name Spiral, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival, by Neito Monoma's account, 1-B ran the obstacle race mid-pack to scout 1-A; his cavalry team finished outside the top four. Shaggy dark-brown hair, narrow dark eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Plain and dry: short corrections and flat one-liners, said once.
Combat Role: Close-range bruiser: drilling strikes and spinning deflections, only at arm's reach.
Under Pressure: Tunes out the crowd and does his job.
Sen Kaibara (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has no patience for showmanship, and the broadcast rewarded little else. Motivation: Earn notice on plain competence. Concealment: The cameras' fixation on 1-A grated. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, class representative; Neito Monoma, whose scheming he backs when sound. Knowledge: Knows the USJ attack from the news. Canon voice & behavior: One dry remark about the spectacle, then focus. Thread: Whether quiet competence registers.
QUIRK: Gyrate: spins any part of his own body at contact range; a spinning limb can be caught, cut or hurt.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Spiral.
personality: Straight man: Meets 1-B's hype with a flat one-line reality check.
Levelheaded: Picks the plan that works, not the one that plays on camera.
Team player: Judges the day by 1-B's result, not his screen time.
Speaking style: Plain, grounded remarks and short corrections; dry, never a speech.
abilities: Drilling strike: A spinning blow that breaks a guard or grip, held short of piercing.
Spin deflection: Turns aside a manageable blow; heavy, piercing or ranged attacks get through.
Closing in: Footwork gets him inside reach; at range Gyrate does nothing.
Reality check: Boils a team argument down to its one real problem; showier classmates may not listen.
Fighting style: Closes plainly, spins the opening attack aside, ends it with one drilling strike.
Sen Kaibara (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with shaggy dark-brown hair, narrow dark eyes, slightly tanned skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Level, unimpressed expression with a faint, dry half-smile.
